product.title: NBA Surplus Value Championship
product.summary: Pick three players to maximise value received above value paid.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students read a roster showing each player's salary against market value and draft exactly three to maximise total surplus, needing both a surplus threshold and a combined synergy score to win — so the cheapest bargains alone are not enough.

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: A small, complete, publicly reachable puzzle converted from a spreadsheet. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: Playtested end to end 2026-08-16, with the scoring logic read from the shipped JavaScript to confirm the finding. Real multi-objective tension: the three highest-surplus players clear the surplus target but fail the synergy one.
knownBlockers: The win check does not match the stated target. On screen the mission reads TOTAL SURPLUS >= 25; the code computes totalSurplus + synergy >= 25 && synergy >= 6. A roster whose own dashboard showed surplus 24 — visibly under the stated target — still triggered the championship banner and the claim code. In a simulation about reading your numbers, the numbers shown are not the numbers scored.
Because synergy is folded into the surplus check, two high-surplus rookies plus exactly one veteran reliably clears the real condition and shortcuts the intended value reasoning.

curation.tierBasis: Real multi-objective tension between surplus and synergy. Held back by a win check that does not match the target printed on screen, which is a one-line fix in a simulation about reading your own numbers.

provenance.evidence: 201-M4-L2/index.html states 'Surplus = Market Value − Salary' and 'You need ≥ 25 to win.'
